name: Desktop work app
summary: A ferry operator's desk: saved views in a resizable sidebar, a dense table of the day's sailings with a sticky header, an inspector for the selected one, a command menu (⌘K), keyboard shortcuts shown where they apply, and resizable panes. One pane at a time on a narrow window. Loading, empty and error states.
anatomy: Sidebar (views, counts) | edge | top bar (title, day, ⌘K, shortcuts) → filters in one row → sortable table → status line with keys | edge | inspector (time, status, load, crew, log, actions with keys) · delay dialog
